title: Data Augmentation
description: Expand JSONL datasets with rephrase, translate, and style strategies via Ollama, Anthropic, or vLLM. New in v0.25.0.

blocks.html:
Data Augmentation

soup data augment expands a JSONL dataset with LLM-driven rewrites. Added in v0.25.0.

Usage

blocks.code:
# Rephrase each example 3x
soup data augment \
  --input data.jsonl \
  --output augmented.jsonl \
  --strategy rephrase \
  --count 3

# Translate to other languages
soup data augment --input data.jsonl --strategy translate --lang ru,zh,es

# Rewrite in multiple styles
soup data augment --input data.jsonl --strategy style --styles formal,casual,technical

blocks.html:
Strategies

StrategyPurpose
rephrasePreserve meaning, diversify wording
translateAdd examples in other languages for multilingual fine-tuning
styleRewrite in formal / casual / technical / etc. tones

Providers

Augmentation uses the judge providers: ollama, anthropic, vllm. Select with --provider.

blocks.code:
soup data augment \
  --input data.jsonl \
  --strategy rephrase \
  --count 2 \
  --provider ollama \
  --dedup

blocks.html:
Flags

FlagMeaning
--input, -iThe source JSONL (required)
--output, -oWhere to write; default augmented.jsonl
--strategy, -srephrase (default) / translate / style
--provider, -pollama (default), anthropic or vllm
--countAugmentation multiplier for rephrase (default 2, 1 to 10). translate and style ignore it and write one variant per language or style
--langTarget languages for translate, comma-separated: at most 10 entries of 32 characters each
--stylesStyle list for style, comma-separated: at most 10 entries of 32 characters each
--modelModel id to ask the provider for
--base-urlProvider endpoint for ollama or vllm. An Ollama server must be on localhost; a remote vLLM server must use HTTPS, and since v0.75.2 its host may not be a private, link-local or reserved IP address (name it by hostname). A host written only as numbers that is not a valid IPv4 address (10.0.0.256, 4294967296) is refused too (v0.76.0). anthropic needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY instead
--requests-per-minuteClient-side rate limit, 1 to 600 (default 60)
--dedupDeduplicate augmented + original data

When the provider fails (v0.76.0)

A call that fails (a transport error, a non-200 status, a malformed reply) or returns an empty or whitespace-only reply never becomes a row: that variant is dropped, and a row is never written with an empty or unrewritten field. The summary reports N of M provider calls failed for --provider <name> (<endpoint>); first error: .... When no call produced a usable row the command prints No usable rows produced and exits 1 without writing an output file. A partial outage keeps the rows that succeeded and shows them under a yellow panel that reports the failure count.

Re-run this. Through v0.75.2 soup data augment built its provider so that a connection error, an HTTP 404, 429 or 500, or a malformed reply came back as empty text. A rephrase, translate or style pass over a provider that was down or rate-limiting wrote rows whose rewritten field was "" next to the originals, and the command exited 0. Open an augmented file made that way and look for empty fields. soup distill-prompt had the same defect from the other side: it dropped every failed row and wrote an empty file with Rows: 0, also with exit 0.

Safety

  • Input/output paths are resolved and constrained to the current working directory.
  • Output format must match the input format, enforced after generation.
  • --count is capped at 10 to prevent accidental 1000× blow-ups.
  • Requests honor --requests-per-minute inherited from soup data generate.
